Characterization_methods: high-energy X-ray diffraction (HE-XRD) coupled to atomic pair distribution function (PDF) analysis
Proof in the paper: The HRTEM images and EDS mapping reveal the core–shell structure of the Fe–Ni nanoparticles, with nanocrystalline regions and a thin oxide layer. The XPS and XAFS results indicate the presence of α-Ni(OH)2, β-NiOOH, metallic Fe, Fe(OH)3, Fe2O3, and Fe3O4 phases. The HE-XRD and PDF analysis provide further structural information, showing limited long-range order and suggesting significant structural disorder in the nanoparticles.
